text.en: A consumer's spending choices are driven only by which single good gives the most satisfaction per purchase, with no consideration of a limited budget shared across many goods -- in reality, consumer-choice theory models a rational consumer as maximizing total utility across their entire consumption bundle subject to a fixed budget constraint, meaning the value of spending one more unit of money on a good is always weighed against what that same money could instead buy elsewhere.
text.et: Tarbija kulutusvalikuid juhib ainult see, milline üksik kaup annab ostu kohta kõige rohkem rahulolu, arvestamata piiratud eelarvet, mida jagatakse paljude kaupade vahel -- tegelikult modelleerib tarbijavaliku teooria ratsionaalset tarbijat kui kogurahulolu maksimeerijat kogu tarbimiskorvi ulatuses fikseeritud eelarvepiirangu tingimustes, mis tähendab, et ühe lisaraha ühiku kulutamise väärtust kaubale kaalutakse alati selle vastu, mida sama raha saaks selle asemel mujal osta.
